{{Top|leg}}
'''Synthweave''' was a tough fabric that lasted for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and was both fireproof and electrically non-conductive. [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] manufactured a [[shipsuit]] that was made of synthweave.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
